mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is not followed by a tightening monetary policy or if the S&P 500 shows positive returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month is not followed by negative S&P 500 returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops > 5% MoM is not followed by negative S&P 500 returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases are not followed by positive S&P 500 returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% year-over-year, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is not followed by negative S&P 500 returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS drops > 100k in 1 month is not followed by negative S&P 500 returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 5% YoY is not followed by positive S&P 500 returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is increasing and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is decreasing, it signals a strengthening economy with improving labor conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases is not followed by positive S&P 500 returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
